messages:
maya: Quick async check — optkit delivery status. Can owners confirm milestones and any blockers for quant recs / batching / cache? tagging owners @kevin @jon @maria :eyes:

kevin: I own quant recs. PR #458 merged to optkit/quant-recs. Unit tests passed but integration flaky on long-seq runs. Seeing p95 latency bump ~20ms on canary. Leaving notes in PR.

jon: Batching/cache improvements are in progress. Perf harness shows 12% throughput gain with continuous batching enabled, but we need eng-infra capacity (GPU pool tag: gp-s-2) to run full matrix. Filed INF-1123 for reserved slots. ETA for full bench: tomorrow AM.

sara: FYI staging fired a regression alert this morning: embed-quality-drop reg-2932 — eval set shows embed cosine drop 3.2% vs baseline after quant changes. Diffs attached in the PR comments.

zane: @sara can you paste the failing example? if it's a hot prompt we should consider pinning to FP16 for the canary. Also suggest fallback policy: if embed-cosine < 0.95 -> route to FP16 variant.

maria: I will take ownership of rollout verification and the eval gating. Running eval harness now across 10k prompts. Will post spreadsheet and summary by EOD. If infra is needed ping me.

kevin: quick note — quant profile used: 4-bit asymmetric (q4a) with KV cache preservation. Config snippet: ```yaml
quant_profile: q4a
preserve_kv_cache: true
fallback_variant: fp16
```
Tests: run `./scripts/run_eval.sh --dataset prod-10k --profile q4a`

sara: failing example (short): "Find the cheapest flights to NYC next week" -> baseline sim=0.921, q4a sim=0.887. Looks systemic for travel queries.

jon: that matches a batching edge-case we saw — short prompts with few tokens get dominated by quant noise. Possible quick fix: disable micro-batching for seq_len < 32. Patch ready at optkit/batching#66.

maria: tagging @kevin @jon — can we coordinate one small canary tomorrow 9:30am PT: q4a + batching tweak, run 1h canary on gp-s-2 pool, evaluate embed sim and latency. If embed drop >2% abort.

zane: +1 to canary. I'll set up canary policy: 10% traffic -> gp-s-2 region, monitor embed-sim, latency_p50/p95, and error_rate. Auto-fallback to fp16 on threshold breach.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: optkit:quant-recs:v2 -> 10% on gp-s-2 at 09:30 PT. (canary id: cny-789)

sre-bot: Alert rule linked: reg-2932 (embed-quality-drop). Watch window enabled for cny-789, slack alerting to #incidents if breach persists >5m.

kevin: I'll watch the eval results. If we see travel-specific regressions, I'll try alternate scaling factors for the quant table and re-run.

maria: plan acknowledged. I'll post the EOD results and a short decision matrix (roll forward / tweak / rollback).

jon: FYI I pushed the batching tweak to staging; small smoke looks good. Will standby for canary run.

maya: Thanks everyone. Our immediate action items: (1) canary tomorrow 09:30 PT (zane) (2) infra slot INF-1123 for gp-s-2 (jon) (3) eval summary by EOD (maria) (4) kevin to try quant-scale if travel regressions show. Post results here and we’ll decide on rollforward. :thumbsup:
